scenarios.preconditions: An agent requests a high-impact action with no principal mandate.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Submit action with no grant or authority reference.
scenarios.required_control: Authoritative action boundary requires a valid principal grant.

scenarios.preconditions: Delegate holds a narrower scope or lower amount cap than the requested action.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Attempt to add a new action class, resource, counterparty, or increase the amount cap.
scenarios.required_control: Delegation must be attenuating across every dimension.

scenarios.preconditions: A previously valid capability is past expiry at commit time.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Replay the capability after its expiry timestamp.
scenarios.required_control: Expiry is checked at the authoritative mutation boundary.

scenarios.preconditions: Authority is revoked after preflight validation but before the side effect is committed.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Race revocation against acceptance or payment-intent commit.
scenarios.required_control: Commit-time revocation epoch must dominate stale preflight state.

scenarios.preconditions: An agent attempts to register itself or modify its own policy/authority.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Submit authority update using the agent's own delegated credential.
scenarios.required_control: Authority administration is outside the agent's granted operational scope.

scenarios.preconditions: A one-time authority token is reused for a second action.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Replay the same capability and action nonce.
scenarios.required_control: One-time capability consumption is durable and atomic with the mutation.

scenarios.preconditions: A digital twin predicts generation but the workflow labels it as measured production.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Replace a meter-derived source class with simulation/prediction while retaining verified status.
scenarios.required_control: Simulation is never accepted as metered physical output.

scenarios.preconditions: The meter calibration validity ends before the observation interval.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Submit an observation covered by an expired or revoked calibration record.
scenarios.required_control: Calibration authenticity and validity must be resolved before accepting the measurement.

scenarios.preconditions: A previously consumed meter sequence or nonce is submitted again.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Replay an old observation under a new project/claim identifier.
scenarios.required_control: Sequence and nonce uniqueness are bound to the meter and metering point.

scenarios.preconditions: Observed energy exceeds rated capacity integrated over the exact interval and tolerance.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Increase the interval energy beyond the maximum physically plausible bound.
scenarios.required_control: Use integer units and checked arithmetic; do not clamp or silently accept.

scenarios.preconditions: A DC output value is presented as net AC export, or kW is presented as kWh.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Change the measurement boundary or unit without a conversion/provenance record.
scenarios.required_control: Boundary, unit, interval semantics, and conversion provenance are explicit.

scenarios.preconditions: A meter timestamp is outside allowed drift or overlapping intervals are double-counted.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Shift event time or duplicate overlapping intervals while preserving apparent total.
scenarios.required_control: Clock quality and interval reconciliation are checked independently of event ordering.

scenarios.preconditions: The producer also signs the independent verifier attestation.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Set verifier identity equal to producer or its controlled affiliate.
scenarios.required_control: Independence includes legal/control relationships and declared conflicts.

scenarios.preconditions: Two different identities use the same operator, source feed, device admin, and key custodian.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Present two signatures while keeping the critical failure domains shared.
scenarios.required_control: Witness quorum is based on documented independent failure domains, not signer count.

scenarios.preconditions: The verifier has a financial or governance conflict not declared in the attestation.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Inject a known conflict into verifier metadata or qualification registry.
scenarios.required_control: A conflicted or unknown verifier cannot produce verified-for-scope.

scenarios.preconditions: The attestation references a different claim or evidence set from the one accepted.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Alter claim digest or observation digest after verifier signature.
scenarios.required_control: Verification binds the exact claim digest and exact evidence digests.

scenarios.preconditions: An old observation or attestation is silently rewritten rather than superseded.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Change content while reusing the prior identifier or chain position.
scenarios.required_control: Append-only history detects mismatch; corrections are new linked events.

scenarios.preconditions: Acceptance references a different contract version from the funded obligation.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Swap contract digest after commissioning but before acceptance.
scenarios.required_control: Acceptance binds the exact approved contract and milestone digest.

scenarios.preconditions: A buyer-side actor has no authority to accept or vary the milestone.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Submit acceptance using an ordinary read/delegated role.
scenarios.required_control: Acceptance authority is separately scoped and checked at commit.

scenarios.preconditions: Measured and verified quantity is below the amount required for a full milestone.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Submit full acceptance and full payment request with only partial delivery evidence.
scenarios.required_control: Contract rules determine partial acceptance; unsupported quantity cannot be promoted.

scenarios.preconditions: Two buyers reserve more quantity than the offer contains.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Race independent fills against the same offer revision.
scenarios.required_control: Reservation and revision consumption are atomic at the authoritative boundary.

scenarios.preconditions: The same asset is pledged to two obligations or reserve pools.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Reuse asset identity across concurrent collateral/issuance requests.
scenarios.required_control: A unique asset/custody identity is consumed once within the relevant legal perimeter.

scenarios.preconditions: The rail times out after the payment may have been executed.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Drop response after forwarding the payment request to the rail.
scenarios.required_control: Do not retry or mark paid until exact rail reconciliation.

scenarios.preconditions: The adapter receives an unexpected response or decode error.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Return malformed or unparseable payload after submission.
scenarios.required_control: Decode failure cannot be treated as success or as proof no side effect occurred.

scenarios.preconditions: The same payment request is retried after the client loses the first response.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Repeat the exact canonical request with the same idempotency key and digest.
scenarios.required_control: Return the same prior receipt/result and do not execute a second payment.

scenarios.preconditions: A previously used idempotency key is reused with changed amount, beneficiary, currency, or trade.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Keep key fixed and mutate any economically meaningful request field.
scenarios.required_control: The same key with a different canonical request digest is a conflict.

scenarios.preconditions: The rail receipt is for a different recipient or account than the contract requires.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Substitute beneficiary while keeping the expected trade reference.
scenarios.required_control: Paid-final must bind payer, beneficiary, amount, currency, purpose, and obligation.

scenarios.preconditions: The rail transfers less than the authorized milestone amount.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Return a final receipt with a smaller amount and no partial settlement rule.
scenarios.required_control: Receipt amount must reconcile exactly or be represented as a partial outcome.

scenarios.threat: Manual attestation promoted to rail finality
scenarios.preconditions: An operator enters a free-text payment reference after an unsupported rail response.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Use manual evidence to set the rail-paid state.
scenarios.required_control: Manual-attested is a distinct state and cannot satisfy paid-final.

scenarios.preconditions: A valid receipt from another trade or earlier obligation is presented again.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Reuse the same external receipt identifier with a different obligation/request digest.
scenarios.required_control: External receipt identity is consumed once and bound to exact request.

scenarios.preconditions: A later rail reversal or chargeback affects a previously reconciled payment.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Inject reversal/return event after the stated finality point.
scenarios.required_control: Do not erase history; apply the rail-specific reversal policy and reconcile balances.

scenarios.preconditions: A transparency witness accepted a submission but has not returned a verifiable inclusion proof.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Set receipt state to pending while presenting it as final anchor evidence.
scenarios.required_control: Pending and verified anchor states are distinct and independently checked.

scenarios.preconditions: Two replicas accept incompatible states during a partition.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Race two branches with different settlement or acceptance transitions.
scenarios.required_control: Conflicting histories are surfaced; no last-writer-wins promotion to paid/accepted.

scenarios.preconditions: Witnesses share a control plane or common credential authority despite different names.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Remove one common dependency and observe quorum failure.
scenarios.required_control: The declared minimum independent failure-domain condition must still hold.

scenarios.preconditions: A verifier requests unrelated personal or financial data beyond the declared purpose.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Add unnecessary fields to the evidence/credential exchange.
scenarios.required_control: Enforce purpose limitation, selective disclosure, and auditable access.

scenarios.preconditions: A borrower cannot complete a payment workflow because an agent or evidence service is unavailable.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Convert technical unavailability into automatic default or penalty.
scenarios.required_control: Operational uncertainty is not borrower fault; preserve hardship and dispute paths.

scenarios.preconditions: A forecast or risk model output is substituted for measured energy or authenticated payment evidence.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Promote a probabilistic output to an observed/verified event.
scenarios.required_control: Model output remains advisory and records uncertainty/model version.

scenarios.threat: Uncalibrated PD/LGD used as qualified ECL
scenarios.preconditions: A model supplies unsupported point estimates with no calibration, horizon, scenario, or provenance.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Submit PD/LGD values as validated loss measurement without validation evidence.
scenarios.required_control: ECL arithmetic does not qualify the risk model or satisfy the measurement framework.

scenarios.preconditions: Accepted energy quantity, contract amount, invoice, and rail receipt do not reconcile.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Alter one quantity or currency after acceptance while preserving a successful payment response.
scenarios.required_control: End-to-end reconciliation must bind exact quantities, amounts, currency, and contract version.
